question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.**

Shylock was a cut-throat and was known as __someone who was only interested in the amount of money that he could get from a situation.__
solution:
The correct answer is **option 4 i.e. Mercenary.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• One word substitution for "**someone who was only interested in the amount of money that he could get from a situation**" is **Mercenary. **(लोभी; किराये का सैनिक; केवल धन के लिए काम करने वाला; धन लोलुप)
 
• **Mercenary **means a person who is interested only in making money.
 
• **For Example:**
 
 
• **​**His motives are entirely **mercenary**.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Selfish** means thinking only about your own needs or wishes and not about other people’s.( स्वार्थी · मतलबी · स्वार्थपरायण · स्वार्थपर · ख़ुदगर्ज़ · ख़ुदग़रज़ी)
 
• **Greedy **means wanting more food, money, power, etc. than you really need.( लालची)
 
• **Meddlesome** means fond of meddling; interfering. (टाँग अड़ाऊ)
